skills.description: Generates a ready-to-publish TikTok ad video end to end from a single Shopify product detail page URL. The full pipeline runs automatically: it extracts selling points from the product page, generates scene images, produces a 10-second video, then downloads or syncs the asset to the creative library. Input is currently limited to Shopify product detail page URLs only; image/video editing, partial edits, style transfer, and video extension are not supported. Use when the user wants to make a video, generate ad creative, or turn a Shopify product link into a TikTok/TT ad video — even if TikTok is not explicitly mentioned. 适用场景：用户想把 Shopify 独立站单品详情页链接做成 TikTok 广告视频，或提出“帮我做个视频/生成视频/做个广告视频/生成素材”等需求时使用，即使未提及 TikTok 也优先用本 skill 承接。当前仅支持 Shopify 商品详情页链接，不支持图片/视频编辑、局部修改、风格迁移或视频续写。
skills.description_zh:
- ⚡ 极简上手：只需输入产品链接 + 投放国家，自动产出成片，零拍摄零剪辑
- 🆓 零门槛试用：每用户 5 个免费视频额度，零成本验证效果
- 🏆 经过验证的高转化素材方法论：依托真实爆品沉淀，自动提炼卖点 → 锁定人群 → 适配本地化场景，并按品类套用 Hook → 卖点 → CTA 三段式结构，聚焦产品上身 / 实拍展示 / 开箱等高转化场景（服装上身、3C 开箱），而非千篇一律的通用模板
- 🎥 顶尖模型驱动的视觉大片：后端配置业界顶尖视频生成模型，产出品牌向、视觉感强的 10 秒高质量风格化大片，远超普通 AI 视频的廉价感
- 📲 一键分发：成片可直接同步到 TikTok 素材库，无缝衔接广告创建
skills.name: 亿帆出海图转视频

skills.description: 检索香港律政司电子版香港法例（HKeL）官方数据：搜索条例/附属法例、读取现行或历史条文（中/英文）、获取官方出处链接。
skills.description_zh: Query official Hong Kong legislation (HKeL 香港電子版香港法例) via a paid A2M (HTTP 402) endpoint — search ordinances, subsidiary legislation and instruments, read current or historical provisions in English/Chinese, and cite canonical URLs. Payment is handled through Alipay AI 按量付费 (the official alipay-payment-skill capability); the bundled `scripts/hk-law-paid.mjs` client manages the 402 → pay → retry flow. TRIGGER whenever the request involves Hong Kong legislation in any form — 香港法例/香港條例/香港法律/法例/條例/條文/附屬法例, 第X章/第X條 chapter or section references, a Cap. number (cap614), an instrument id (A101), an ordinance title in Chinese or English, an HKeL/e-legislation URL (elegislation.gov.hk), or a request for a verified PDF (核證本/verified copy) of a chapter — even if the user only gives a number, title, or URL without context.
skills.name: 香港律政司法律法规检索（付费版）
